## History

John Henry Carter was a young boy from [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) who was hired by Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) and initiated the spread of local stories. He helped [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) clean [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and prepare a special meal in anticipation of a visit from famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P0](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0000), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P1](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0001), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P2](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0002), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P3](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0003), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P4](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0004), +43 more_

## Quotes

> "Oh, ain’t this awful, Miss Cuthbert? Mr. Harrison sent me over to see if yous had come out all right."
>
> — John Henry Carter — [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P39](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0039)

> "Yas’m. Not quite so well, ma’am. We was struck. The lightning knocked over the kitchen chimbly and come down the flue and knocked over Ginger’s cage and tore a hole in the floor and went into the sullar. Yas’m."
>
> — John Henry Carter — [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P41](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0041)

> "Yas’m. He was hurt pretty bad. He was killed."
>
> — John Henry Carter — [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043)
